fields.label: Theme
fields.description: Use the same palette for the interface, terminal and syntax highlighting. Add themes as JSON files in the configuration folder.

fields.label: Interface scale
fields.description: Scale the whole interface. Terminal and diff font sizes can also be adjusted separately.

fields.label: Density
fields.description: Adjust spacing in navigation, work items and file lists.

fields.label: Terminal font size
fields.description: Font size for embedded agent terminals. Changes apply to open terminals.

fields.label: Terminal scrollback
fields.description: Maximum lines retained in each terminal view.

fields.label: Diff font size
fields.description: Font size for full reviews and single-file previews.

fields.label: Full review layout
fields.description: Default layout when opening a full review.

fields.label: Single-file layout
fields.description: Default layout when opening an individual file.

fields.label: File preview height
fields.description: Height of a single-file preview, as a percentage of the chat area.

fields.label: Enter submits a comment
fields.description: Submit a selected-line comment with Enter. Use Shift+Enter for a newline.

fields.label: Default agent
fields.description: Agent selected for new chats. Existing chats keep their agent.

fields.label: Diff editor
fields.description: Zed opens file diffs. VS Code and Cursor open the selected worktree.

fields.label: Claude review skill
fields.description: Optional slash command for the review skill in Claude, such as /review. The skill defines its reviewer roles.

fields.label: Codex review skill
fields.description: Optional skill command for Codex, such as $review. Leave empty to disable agent review.
